Narrator.title: Paddington—British narrator, deep and warm (Keeper of the Forest)

Michael.title: calm storyteller male (stand-in until family voice clone)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Dad, look! Shooting stars! In the daytime!

lines.speaker: Great Black Dragon
lines.text: MY eggs! Come back here this instant! Oh, bother.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Do not be afraid, little family. I am the Keeper of the Forest.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: That dragon is proud, and she is lonely. She took four eggs to make a family that must follow her.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Your tutor, Renee, is my Ward, and my wife. She threw the eggs far away to keep them safe. Now they need you.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Our teacher did that?

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Hold out your hands. Speed for Joshua. Fire for Daniel. Ice for Vanessa. Strength for Michael.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Prove yourselves worthy, and these gifts are yours to keep. First, find your way out of these woods and free the Great Bear.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Then we had better make it a good day. Stay close, boys.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: I'm stuck! Somebody swap in! Hee hee, stop it!

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: A web is too sticky for one. Call your family.

lines.speaker: Vanessa
lines.text: Got you. Up you come.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: There. The spell is gone. He was never angry at you.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: He's smiling! Can a bear smile?

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Well done. Renee sends word from the castle. The dragon is searching for the eggs. A baby dragon grows up to be like whoever loves it first. Reach each one before her spell does.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: See how it glows? It can hear you coming, Joshua.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Hi. I'm Joshua. I'll look after you. I promise.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: I think you have a friend for life, son.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: It's so hot in here. Mommy, can you make it snow?

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Feel that? He is only warm now, like a hearth. Renee tells me the dragon knows two eggs have hatched. Hurry on.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: You're warm. Hello, Ember. I'm Daniel. I've got you.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Now we both have one! Speedy, say hi!

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Everyone warm enough? Daniel, stay near your mother.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: That ice is too thick for a small flame. Ask Ember to help.

lines.speaker: Vanessa
lines.text: Hello, little one. I'm Vanessa. You're safe with us.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Mommy has a dragon! Mommy has a dragon!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Three dragons. One more. Come on, Dad, it's your turn!

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Rest now, old friend. Your watch is over.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Well, hello there. I'm Michael. Strong little fellow, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Vanessa
lines.text: Four eggs, four dragons. Now let's go home.

lines.speaker: Renee
lines.text: This way, children. She is right below the hall.

lines.speaker: Great Black Dragon
lines.text: Those are MY dragons! They were going to follow ME!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: They don't follow us. They're our friends.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Look at them. They are not afraid of you. They never were.

lines.speaker: Great Black Dragon
lines.text: I only wanted a family of my own, I only wanted somewhere to live where I feel loved and wanted.

lines.speaker: Vanessa
lines.text: You can't force people to love you, but you can choose to be kind, you can choose how to treat others, and in return you'll find love, friends, and maybe a family of your own.

lines.speaker: Great Black Dragon
lines.text: I don't think anyone could love me.

lines.speaker: Vanessa
lines.text: Have you tried being kind to others? Why don't you stay? Come to the festival, meet the people who live here, spend time with the baby dragons, you might realize you can have everything you want when you treat others with kindness and respect.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: You have proved yourselves worthy. The gifts are yours to keep. But your best gift was always each other.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Can the dragons stay?

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Ask them.

lines.speaker: Renee
lines.text: The eggs and the family are safe, my dear. It's time for me to come home.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: I have missed you, my love.

lines.speaker: Great Black Dragon
lines.text: Hmph. It is a rather nice festival.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And so the Dragon did just that. She stayed for the festival, she laughed for the first time in her life and realized how beautiful life can be when we look for the good in the world instead of the darkness. And in the end, she found the family she had been looking for and became the Protector of the Kingdom, loved by everyone, and they all lived happily ever after.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Let Daniel burn away that tangle.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Michael is strong enough for that.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Vanessa can freeze a path here.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Joshua is fast enough to make it.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Michael and Samson can open that gate.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Vanessa and Frosty can bridge this water.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Joshua and Speedy can dash right across.
